thesis: The narrator observes Mara absorbing unassigned work, benefits personally, then is invited to select people; authority turns his analysis into a temptation.

ideas.statement: School models show hidden rules and symbolic criticism; examine whether justified challenge actually changes decisions.
Mara takes three unclaimed tasks while narrator leaves; passion legitimization research is bounded, her agency and delegation flaws remain, and his invitation flatters him.
Deferred hope and moral purity can constrain or challenge authority; political use does not decide belief truth and no divine verdict follows.
Hypothetical machines could exploit guilt or detect overload depending on control and objectives; character presentation is not worth.
